transcript.text: Follow the [ __ ] script. If your team

point in having a script. Script

transcript_only_text:
Follow  the  [ __ ]  script.  If  your  team 
 does  not  follow  the  script,  there  is  no 
 point  in  having  a  script.  Script 
 adherence,  in  my  opinion,  is  the  first 
 thing  that  you  drill.  I  would  rather 
 have  100%  of  my  team  saying  script  word 
 for  word  and  us  close  no  one,  because 
 then  I  could  then  change  the  script  and 
 then  get  everyone  to  close.  If  people 
 aren't  following  the  script,  you  can't 
 change  anything.  The  first  part  of  the 
 sale,  the  first  2/3  of  the  sale,  should 
 be  pretty  much  word  for  word  the  same.
